pages.text: Open a $(item)DNA Sequencer$() and press the $(l)Directory$() tab: the 82 vanilla creatures by department, each with its spawn egg. A cell is stamped when your team $(l)samples$() the species, $(l)jars$() its head, or $(l)rides$() it as a host. Teammates share one Directory; alone, it is yours.

Point at a cell for its blood, tool, genes and your reads, its title and the jar it needs; a blank cell gives a hint. Three are $(l)[REDACTED]$() until filed. 10 species stamped: a memo. 25 jarred: $(l)Headhunter$(). All 77 species on the books sampled: $(l)Complete Census$().$(br2)$(o)Every position will be filled.$()
